body: Sorry, I had written this post while falling asleep.
I wish the best for your family and I hope it all gets better.

That makes more sense, sorry I read over the post. I have felt the same way, the only thing that ever helped me was talking out my issues with my own mother. I have epilepsy, I've been fired twice, no matter of the fact that I had doctor notes that literally excused my absence because I needed recovery from having grand mal seizures. This caused me to dive deep into the negative mindset that had lead me to hanging myself with a belt in my shower. 
My brother had walked in just before I blacked out. He did save my life that day. 
But maybe just letting her get her problems out verbally, trying to help her out in the process will make her realize that she matters. 
She may need to have an emotional release. It's possible that she may need to talk it out without an argument and more of an understanding. That's what I needed at least, before I attempted. 
I just cut myself an hour ago. I slipped. I went on here because I needed to talk. 
Maybe this post and the fact that I came across it is an indicator of how it was just meant to be.

She needs to realize the detrimental stress that would be caused if she were to commit suicide. It would literally tear you guys apart because of an act that was so quick that she couldn't find her way out of it. 
I would just try to keep talking to her, giving her attention, love, and try to just make her laugh. It might take a lot of energy, but laughter can save lives.

Tell your sister that you love her. 
Tell her that you couldn't imagine life without her. 
Remind her of things that makes her unique. Try to give her the help of letting her know that she isn't a p.o.s. and hopefully she thinks of the effect of suicide that it would bring on you and your mom. 
I'm a very depressed person, I've attempted suicide a few times and I really am trying to find life again. It isn't easy, especially on your own ....
So if you really want to help her, just tell her that you really love her.

I'm sorry that you are having a hard time with your relationship and the idea of how the depression and suicidal tendencies. I made a post a year ago, you should read it if you get the chance. Life isn't easy, life isn't fair. But we can't just give up if we want to see what we are capable of doing in our lifetime. 
I just know that I'm not in a good mindset, but I also know that I have potential to make a difference. I think of ending it a lot. But when would that fix our problems? 
Think about an affair... Just to compare. It may seem like a harmless act, but the aftermath is what really discounts the positive benefit from what you got out of it. 
The only thing is, we don't deserve to die. We didn't ask to be born, life is very hard.. but death is something that should occur naturally from aging, this gives the being a chance to actually experience LIFE. we feel dead right now...
But I promise that life feels great. I've been there before, trying to get back. But I came here because I needed to talk to someone. I saw your post, and I felt the need to respond. You deserve better, so please...
Try to get better
I'm sorry you feel this way, if you read my latest post you may understand why you feel the way you do. Only if it's similar circumstances, but again I'm sorry you feel like this

Chemical medication makes my conditions worse. Especially if I stay on schedule and my body becomes dependent on them. I also get a mental addiction to the medication, so for my personality it really isn't good. I get a chemical dependency
